description: The new CLI advertises three native loading controls it does not use.
trigger: Invoke the new script with `--gpu_split`, `--load_metrics`, or `--override`.
expected_behavior: An accepted loading option should take effect as advertised or be rejected as unsupported by this backend.
actual_behavior: The shared parser accepts all three, but the script unconditionally asks Transformers for automatic placement and never reads those arguments. The native evaluator calls `model_init.init`, which parses the split, prints metrics on request, and installs tensor overrides. The discrepancy reaches the new standalone CLI, not the existing native CLI.

verification.description: Compared options registered by the shared helper with both standalone entry points and the native init consumer.
verification.limits: No CLI invocation or model load was executed.

introductions.rationale: The new entry point registers three native loader options through model_init.add_args, then loads via Transformers without consuming them.
